newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Rotterdam bunkers dip, drawing in large volumes.
newsitem.headline: Rotterdam bunkers dip, drawing in large volumes.

text.p: Rotterdam bunker prices dipped on Thursday, leading to a large volume of enquiries, while prices in most other ports rose, dealers said.
Rotterdam 380 CST bunkers dipped by about $2 to $90/$91 fob as the barge market softened. Barge weakness came at the conclusion of one trading house's strategy of propping up the market.
Total ARA market volume was over 20,000 tonnes with around four enquiries each topping 3,000 tonnes.

"It might be a coincidence. Maybe there are just a lot of ships in the area. I suspect it is more a case of people buying on the dips. You can never be sure where the market will go from here," one supplier said.
Hamburg prices were slightly firmer and volume thin.
Mediterranean bunkers were mostly $1 a tonne firmer for fuel oil and $3/$4 higher for gas oil.
Only southern France saw large volumes. Suppliers said the very competitive prices meant ship owners were keen to pick up product if their vessels were in the area.
